title: Taskflow Agent finds cross-thread pin authorization flaw in Signal iOS
summary: The client validates group membership against the incoming envelope thread but performs a thread-blind message lookup, allowing an attacker to unpin a targeted message in a group they are not part of on one recipient’s device.
ai_role: GHSL directly credits discovery to Taskflow Agent and verification by Jaroslav Lobačevski. Signal reported a collision with another report on 2026-04-15 and released a fix in 8.7.0.1523 that day; the AI report is not shown to be first. No CVE assigned.
classification_note: The cited sources document the finding and remediation; they do not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: Fixed in Signal iOS 8.7.0.1523 on 2026-04-15. GHSL rates the effect low and local to the target device; it requires knowledge of the message timestamp and author ACI. Signal reported a collision with another report.
